data.narrative:
Nuclearn.ai is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Bradley Fox and Jerrold Vincent that has raised $10.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Valar Atomics at Series B valued at $6.0B, Nano Nuclear Energy at Seed valued at $808M, and Fuse Energy at Series A valued at $200M), supplemented by a broader nuclear energy comp universe of 11 total peers including public companies OKLO, NNE, and SMR.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $10.5M raised, yielding $21M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector comparables produced $808M, reflecting the wide dispersion in nuclear energy valuations at this stage ($200M–$6.0B range). The median peer valuation is substantially higher than the stage-progression result, likely due to elevated investor appetite for advanced nuclear technologies and the outsized valuations of earlier-stage peers in the comp set.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $18M (low, floor from stage-progression) to $929M (high). The median implied value is $414M. Key uncertainties include the appropriate weighting between financing-history-based methods and peer benchmarking in a sector where valuations reflect highly variable risk appetites and technology differentiation. The wide peer range ($200M–$6.0B) underscores sensitivity to stage-specific and company-specific factors.
